**Breaking change: This version removes all implementation and example files, leaving only documentation.**

- Removed all source scripts, configuration, templates, evaluators, and example files.
- Only SKILL.md remains; no actual functionality or test data included in this version.
- Users will not be able to run assessments or view report samples in this release.

skill-assessment 1.0.3 — Major update with multilingual, modular static analysis, and configurability.

- Full rewrite of documentation, now in Chinese, with detailed scoring standards, usage, troubleshooting, and extensibility instructions.
- Added modular evaluator scripts for documentation, code, config, and maintenance checks.
- Introduced YAML/JSON configuration options, environment variable overrides, and new examples.
- New install script and improved file structure for better maintainability.
- Enhanced output options: star ratings, detailed multi-dimensional reports, and customizable output formats.

- Major update to documentation for clarity and user guidance
- Simplified instructions: just provide a skill slug to trigger assessment
- Added examples of input and output for easy understanding
- Detailed what checks are performed: security, file organization, and quality scoring
- Listed supported trigger phrases for easy activation
- Highlighted secure analysis: uses only public data, no code execution or private info access
Replace the published skill document with an English release version and align the public description with English-first publishing.

Initial release of skill-assessment – a static analysis tool for OpenClaw skill quality evaluation.

- Provides four-dimensional evaluation: documentation, code quality, configuration friendliness, and maintenance.
- Supports command-line usage for single/batch skill assessment, report generation, and skill comparison.
- Configurable scoring algorithm with weights and detailed configuration via YAML or environment variables.
- Outputs score, star rating, problem list, and saves detailed reports.
- Includes troubleshooting guidance and extension/development documentation.
